an5.7:1.2: asitabyābhaṅgiṃ bhikkhave kulaputto ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti saddho pabbajito kulaputtoti alaṃ vacanāya
an5.7:1.4: labbhā hi bhikkhave yobbanena kāmā te ca kho yādisā vā tādisā vā
an5.7:1.5: ye ca bhikkhave hīnā kāmā ye ca majjhimā kāmā ye ca paṇītā kāmā sabbe kāmātveva saṃkhaṃ gacchanti
an5.7:1.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako dhātiyā pamādamanvāya kaṭṭhaṃ vā kathalaṃ vā mukhe āhareyya
an5.7:1.8: sīghaṃ sīghaṃ manasikaritvā sīghaṃ sīghaṃ āhareyya
an5.7:1.9: no ce sakkuṇeyya sīghaṃ sīghaṃ āharituṃ vāmena hatthena sīghaṃ pariggahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena vaṅkaṅgulaṃ karitvā salohitaṃpi āhareyya
an5.7:1.13: karaṇīyañca kho evaṃ bhikkhave dhātiyā atthakāmāya hitesiniyā anukampikāya anukampaṃ upādāya.
an5.7:1.14: yato ca kho bhikkhave so kumāro vuḍḍho hoti alaṃpañño anapekkhā pana bhikkhave dhātī tasmiṃ kumārasmiṃ hoti
an5.7:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave yāvakīvañca bhikkhuno saddhāya akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu hiriyā akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu ottappena akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu viriyena akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu paññāya akataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu anurakkhitabbo tāva me so bhikkhave bhikkhu hoti
an5.7:2.2: yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saddhāya kataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu hiriyā kataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu ottappena kataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu viriyena kataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu paññāya kataṃ hoti kusalesu dhammesu anapekkho panāhaṃ bhikkhave tasmiṃ homi
